messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Eliminate blank space below reactivePlot, when height is set to a small value
parts:
Leave it as "auto" for reactivePlot. In your ui.R, add height="250px" to plotOutput.

The former controls the height of the PNG (and "auto" means detect the height based on the height of the <div>) and the latter controls the height of the <div>.
